subject: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — scope clarifications & evidence plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kelsey Nguyen <kelsey.nguyen@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — initial scope and a couple of clarifying questions

Kelsey,

Thanks again for the call earlier — useful to see Acme's target FedRAMP timeline. I attached a brief draft of the ISO scope we're proposing (ISO_scope_draft.pdf). Before we lock this down for the auditor prep, two quick clarifications we need from you: 

1) Target systems in scope: does Acme want the managed inference endpoints (customer-facing API) in scope, or only backend admin/ops systems? We should confirm whether customer data flows (API ingress) are included for ISO and FedRAMP.

2) Data residency expectations: you mentioned EU control plane for a subset of customers — can you confirm which accounts/regions must be included under the same scope?

3) Auditor window: do you have a preferred 2-week window in September for the readiness assessment? We can align Redwood's ops and logs team.

Also attaching a short list of baseline evidentiary items we typically provide (logs, retention policy, KMS configs). If you prefer, we can produce a compact evidence bundle for advance review.

Next steps proposed: Acme confirms scope (Q1–Q2 above) by EOD 2026-08-04; Redwood will map internal owners and provide a preliminary evidence index by 2026-08-07.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: ISO_scope_draft.pdf (PDF, 74KB)

From: Kelsey Nguyen <kelsey.nguyen@acme-industries.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: ACME Security <security@acme-industries.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — initial scope and a couple of clarifying questions

Hi Naomi — thanks for the summary and the draft scope. Quick answers inline: 

1) Scope: Acme would like the customer-facing inference endpoints (API) included for FedRAMP readiness — specifically the publicly exposed inference cluster in us-east-1. Backend admin consoles with no customer data can be treated as out-of-scope for initial FedRAMP, but include them for ISO 27001.

2) Data residency: For our EU customers, please include eu-central-1 control plane and the encrypted S3 buckets that store artifacts for those accounts. We have a small subset (~10% of customers) to be treated as EU-scope.

3) Auditor window: September 13–24 works best for us.

Attached is a spreadsheet we completed with some answers to the FedRAMP readiness questionnaire (FedRAMP_Readiness_Questionnaire.xlsx). There are a few items we couldn't fill (service-level encryption algorithm details, KMS rotation cadence) — if you can surface owners that would be great.

Kelsey Nguyen
Director, Information Security
Acme Industries
kelsey.nguyen@acme-industries.com
Attachment: FedRAMP_Readiness_Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel, 220KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — initial scope and a couple of clarifying questions

Looping in procurement and account team notes: Acme's ask to include public inference endpoints for FedRAMP is a deal scope change; finance will need an updated PO for the additional compliance work. Kelsey — can you confirm if Acme will sign an amendment to the SOW? We may need 4–6 weeks for the deeper evidence pull if we include runbooks + raw logs.

Internal owners: Karthik, can you own KMS rotation and encryption algorithms? Laura — can your engineering security team pull the S3 bucket access logs and confirm retention windows? Naomi — I can coordinate timing with the AE and procurement once we have the amendment.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (646) 555-0199

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — initial scope and a couple of clarifying questions

Thanks — Marissa, that's helpful. Karthik / Laura, below is the minimum evidence index I need from your teams to close the questionnaire items Kelsey flagged: 

- KMS: alias list, key rotation schedule, CMKs in use (exportable table)
- Encryption algorithms: TLS versions, cipher suites for public endpoints, at-rest encryption details
- S3: access log exports for the last 90 days for eu-central-1 buckets; lifecycle policy screenshots; bucket policies
- Logs: sample extractor script + one week's export of request logs (redacted PII), plus a description of log storage and retention policy
- Change control: recent change ticket for an infra deployment (link to JIRA) and corresponding approval emails

I'll assemble a compact evidence bundle for Acme by 2026-08-07 for their security team to pre-review before the September assessor window. Please add links to any Drive folders or Jira tickets into this thread when you have them.

Naomi

Attachment: SIG_export_2026.csv (CSV export of our latest SIG inventory)

From: ACME Security <security@acme-industries.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — initial scope and a couple of clarifying questions

Naomi / team,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- Please confirm whether Redwood will redact any customer-identifying fields in the log export and provide the redaction rules.
- The assessor will want a copy of your recent SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12 months). Can you provide a secure link or indicate how you'd like to share it?
- We have engaged a third-party assessor (BrightGate Assessments) — primary contact is Priya Rao (priya.rao@brightgate.com). They'll reach out to coordinate evidence review the week of 2026-08-17.

Also: please share an expected delivery date for the evidence bundle referenced (previously 2026-08-07).

Thanks,
ACME Security
security@acme-industries.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness — initial scope and a couple of clarifying questions

Quick status update: 

- KMS: exported key alias table and rotation cadence notes uploaded to Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cISOscope).
- S3 logs: engineering security has queued a 7-day export for eu-central-1; ETA 2026-08-13.
- SOC 2: Naomi, I can send a secure link to the SOC 2 Type II PDF — recommend using the HubSpot secure file attachment or HelloSign protected link.
- JIRA: created SUP-1234 to track the evidence collection tasks and assigned owners (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SUP-1234).

I'll add the Drive links and attach the export files to SUP-1234. If we aim to provide the compact bundle for Acme by 2026-08-14, that should give BrightGate a week before their review week of 2026-08-17.
